newsitem.title: USA: Dell names new president of Japanese unit.
newsitem.headline: Dell names new president of Japanese unit.

text.p: Dell Computer K.K., the Japanese subsidiary of Dell Computer Corp, said Thursday it has named Chip Saunders as president and representative director.
Before joining Dell, Saunders was corporate vice president and general manager of the U.S./Canada division of Motorola Inc's Radio Products Group.
Dell said Saunders succeeds John Medica, who will return to Dell's world headquarters in Round Rock to assume the position of vice president of worldwide procurement.
Hiroshi Fukino will remain as representative chairman of the company. Saunders and Fukino will report directly to the corporate office of the chief executive.
